name: oxitty-workspace
author: Jeric Bas <jeric.codes@proton.me>
description: High-performance Web TTY daemon built with Rust, React 19, Bun, Vite & tsrs

scripts.build:frontend: bun --filter oxitty-frontend build && rm -rf crates/oxitty/dist && mkdir -p crates/oxitty/dist && cp -r frontend/dist/* crates/oxitty/dist/
scripts.build: bun run build:frontend && bun run build:backend
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run check:lines
